findings.detail: EN 'Riding has always been an unusual skill among British aristocracy' is inverted in RU 'Верховая езда всегда была довольно обычным навыком': change 'обычным' to 'необычным' despite possible authorial oddity.
EN 'Caleb’s mouth tightens' appears as unnatural RU 'Рот Калеба сжимается'; express tightening of lips or face without changing emotional sense.
EN 'had earned him more than his share of doubt over the years' rendered literal 'получил больше своей доли сомнений'; recast to natural Russian conveying that others had doubted his suitability.
